title: Law to require mobile drinking fountains on hot days
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to run a mobile drinking fountain program each summer from June 15 to September 15, deploying fountains to public spaces whenever temperatures are forecast to hit 82 degrees or higher. It would require at least two mobile fountains per council district, with priority given to neighborhoods with high heat vulnerability, and a public online schedule of deployments. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
